visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman wearing a black cap adorned with sparkling silver rhinestones and black-rimmed glasses walks through a bright, modern indoor shopping center. She has a curious and excited expression, looking at the surroundings while speaking directly to the camera as she walks. (2) The woman approaches and enters a high-end beauty retail store with a large red neon sign above the entrance that reads "MECCA". The entrance features a sleek wooden-paneled facade. She continues talking enthusiastically as she transitions from the mall corridor into the shop. (3) Inside the store, the camera captures various displays of skincare products. The woman picks up a red rectangular cosmetic container and then a white tube from the brand Drunk Elephant, holding them up to the lens to show the details of the packaging. (4) Walking through the aisles, the woman smiles broadly, gesturing toward the store's vibrant decor and organized shelves. The background is filled with colorful cosmetics and skincare brands. The lighting is bright and professionally designed. (5) The final segment shows a static white screen with the "DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC" logo in the center, followed by text listing contact information, phone numbers, and two clinic addresses in Taiwan.
